clauses.scope_note: Section L.1: Customer’s use of the Services involving submission of Inputs; OriginalArtifact denotes the Customer-provided Inputs.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_has_all_rights_and_permissions_required_to_submit_inputs means Customer possesses all rights and permissions required to submit the relevant Inputs to the Services.

coverage_notes: Section K’s defense, indemnification, claim exclusions, claim-handling process, and sole-remedy allocation are operative contractual provisions but do not map faithfully to an allowed activity/object permission rule; they are identified as unresolved rather than recast as use conditions.
Section L.1 also contains mutual representations about authority to enter into the Terms and corporate rules; those are not represented as permissions to perform an allowed activity.
Section L.2 and L.3 contain warranty and liability disclaimers or limitations, excluded from activity-constraint rules under the task instructions.

paragraph_audit.reason: Sections K.1–K.5 create reciprocal defense and indemnity duties, define covered claims, specify exclusions and claim-process duties, and make indemnification the exclusive remedy for covered third-party claims. These operative duties and remedial allocations cannot be faithfully represented using the allowed activities and objects.

The Customer representation that it has all rights and permissions required to submit Inputs is captured as a condition on use. Section L.1’s additional mutual representations about authority and corporate rules are operative but do not map to an allowed activity rule. The warranties and liability provisions in L.2–L.3 are nonoperative for this activity-constraint extraction.
